scope: Three actual withdrawn-tool wrist repositioning trials, not vehicle contact turns.

trials.role: Restore the original east pushing orientation.

sample_provenance: Original durable receiver journal reports: READY-side before GO, and GO-side ENTERING before MoveJ. Samples were copied from actual controller reports, never regenerated from nominal poses.
measurement_limit: These are controller-computed FK checks of reported joint paths, not independent physical metrology or proof of exact fixed Z throughout motion.

unchanged_inherited_wrist_validation.correction: The first post-hoc checker incorrectly required measured servo readings to equal planned joints exactly. The corrected audit used the unchanged inherited planned-edge limits and 0.05-degree measured-source tolerance; original reports and the initial audit were retained.

byte_hash_scope: Original durable journal bytes, existing Native records and API receipts; the transport did not retain the original received socket JSON encoding.
state_warning: Historical evidence only. Read current state before further commands; never restore these profiles or replay the trials.
